story: Vidura was the half-brother of Dhritarashtra and Pandu, born to a palace maid. Because of his birth he could never be king, but he became the wisest counsellor at the Kuru court. He spoke against every evil plan and secretly helped the Pandavas escape the house of lac.
belief: He is honoured as an incarnation of Yama, god of dharma. The Vidura Niti, his advice to Dhritarashtra, is still read as a guide to wise living and good government.
turns: His advice was right but rarely followed. He stayed at court for years despite being ignored, and left only when war was already certain.
facts: Krishna chose to stay at Vidura's simple home rather than in Duryodhana's palace.
He resigned from the court before the war.
The Vidura Niti is part of the Udyoga Parva of the Mahabharata.
